stem: During lung-volume testing, a 29-year-old patient exhales normally and then forcefully expels another 1.2 L. A separate measurement shows that 1.4 L remains after maximal expiration. Which of the following was the lung volume immediately after the normal exhalation?

options.explanation: At the end of normal expiration, the lungs contain the additional expiratory reserve plus the residual. Adding 1.2 L and 1.4 L gives 2.6 L.
options.label: A
options.misconception: No misconception: volume after normal expiration includes both expiratory reserve and residual volume.

options.explanation: This is the extra volume expelled after normal expiration. It excludes the 1.4 L that remains even after the patient completes maximal expiration.
options.label: B
options.misconception: Counts the extra expiratory reserve but omits the volume remaining after maximal expiration.

options.explanation: This measures the volume remaining after maximal expiration. At the earlier end of normal expiration, the additional expiratory reserve was still present in the lungs.
options.label: C
options.misconception: Uses the volume after maximal expiration for the earlier volume after normal expiration.

options.explanation: Subtracting the reserve from the residual does not produce functional residual capacity. The two volumes occupy complementary portions of the lung volume after normal expiration.
options.label: D
options.misconception: Subtracts complementary reserve and residual compartments instead of adding them.

options.explanation: This counts the additional expiratory reserve twice. Functional residual capacity contains one expiratory reserve volume plus one residual volume, which total 2.6 L here.
options.label: E
options.misconception: Counts the expiratory reserve twice when reconstructing the volume after normal expiration.

context: Learning objective: Identify functional residual capacity from the expiratory reserve and residual volumes. At the end of normal expiration, the lungs contain the additional expiratory reserve plus the residual. Adding 1.2 L and 1.4 L gives 2.6 L.
